name: Sour Muffin's Sweet First Day of School
source:
A story about how a sharp little muffin tackling her first day of school, and all he challenges that it holds.  She was worried the other cupcakes wouldn't like her, and that she wouldn't fit in. But not only does she work through her fears, she makes a bunch of new friends by the end of the first day.

[Edited from [url=https://williamclarke.itch.io/sour-muffins-sweet-first-day-of-school]itch.io[/url]]
